newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bangchak tenders to buy Oct Mideast crude.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak tenders to buy Oct Mideast crude.

text.p: Bangchak Petroleum Plc of Thailand has issued a tender to buy 500,000 barrels October-lifting Middle Eastern crude grades, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks Oman, Murban, Dubai or similar crudes, traders said. It specifies Oman as the most favourable crude, they added.
The tender closes at 6 p.m. Bangkok time (1100 GMT) on August 28, and offers would be valid until the same time on August 29.
